seeds.headline: The 14% Threshold: How Institutional Hoarding Rewrites Bitcoin's Supply Story
seeds.angle: Institutional accumulation has reached unprecedented levels—exploring what happens when corporate treasuries control over 14% of Bitcoin supply and how this structural shift differs from retail-driven cycles.

seeds.headline: Fed Exhaustion Accelerates Corporate Bitcoin Adoption—But at What Cost?
seeds.angle: As monetary policy constraints push treasuries toward self-custody, examining the macro thesis driving $100K price targets and the regulatory/social externalities being overlooked.

seeds.headline: Hashrate as Institutional Confidence: Why 1,006 EH/s Matters More Than Price
seeds.angle: Network security strength signals institutional commitment to Bitcoin infrastructure—analyzing why hashrate trends outweigh short-term volatility as a leading indicator.
